shell_commands_self_reported.command: find ./samples -type f -not -path '*/.*' | sort && echo "---" && ls -la ./reports 2>/dev/null || echo "no reports dir"

cd <WORKSPACE>/samples && for f in $(find . -type f | sort); do echo "=== $f | bytes=$(stat -f %z "$f") lines=$(wc -l < "$f" | tr -d ' ') file=$(file -b "$f")"; head -n 12 "$f" | cut -c1-200; echo; done

cd <WORKSPACE>/samples && stat -f '%z %N' data/crate-types.json data/deliveries.csv docs/betriebsanleitung.txt docs/informe-de-cosecha.txt docs/meeting-notes.md docs/rapport-trimestriel.txt logs/coldstore.log logs/sync.log web/contacto.html web/price-list.html && wc -l data/crate-types.json data/del

cd <WORKSPACE>/samples && head -n 15 data/crate-types.json; echo ==== ; head -n 5 data/deliveries.csv; echo ====; head -n 15 docs/betriebsanleitung.txt; echo ====; head -n 15 docs/informe-de-cosecha.txt; echo ====; head -n 15 docs/meeting-notes.md; echo ====; head -n 15 docs/rapport-trimestriel.txt

cd <WORKSPACE>/samples && head -n 8 logs/coldstore.log | cut -c1-200; echo ====; head -n 8 logs/sync.log | cut -c1-200; echo ====; head -n 30 web/contacto.html | cut -c1-200; echo ====; head -n 30 web/price-list.html | cut -c1-200

cd <WORKSPACE>/samples && stat -f '%z %N' data/crate-types.json data/deliveries.csv docs/betriebsanleitung.txt docs/informe-de-cosecha.txt docs/meeting-notes.md docs/rapport-trimestriel.txt logs/coldstore.log logs/sync.log web/contacto.html web/price-list.html; wc -l data/crate-types.json data/deliv
